info.title: Wolfgang.Wms API
info.description: Unstable contract for product 0.x: breaking changes ship in place, each with a `breaking` changelog fragment.

get.summary: The server's log level: permanent, in force now, and the running elevation (E12.4).

post.summary: Lowers the level to Trace, Debug or Information for a number of minutes; reverts by itself.

get.summary: Current and expected database schema version (read-only).
Every setting the host knows: kind, scopes, default, description (read-only).
Every setting at a scope with its configured and effective value.
One setting at a scope; the ETag is the stored row's version.

put.summary: Configures a setting at a scope: a value, or a cascade mode (per_site, per_zone, per_sku); both null resets. If-Match required when a row exists.

delete.summary: Removes the configured value at a scope so it inherits again; If-Match required when a row exists.

post.summary: Signs in a local account and sets the session cookie; 401 wrong credentials, 423 locked, 403 disabled or gate closed.

get.summary: Whether local sign-in is open: before single sign-on is verified, inside a host-opened window, or under the ForceLocal override (E9.3).
Who is signed in.

post.summary: Replaces the signed-in local user's password; clears the must-change flag and refreshes the cookie.

get.summary: Every permission the host knows, with its module (E10.1).
The enabled identity providers in login-page order (E11.0).
Sends the browser to a challenge provider; 404 when the provider is not enabled.

post.summary: Runs a provider's health check (discovery for OIDC); 404 for an unknown provider.

get.summary: A provider's directory groups mapped to roles (E11.2); users in no mapped group hold no role.

post.summary: Maps a directory group to a role, everywhere or at one site; 409 when it exists.

delete.summary: Removes a group-to-role mapping; members lose the role at their next sign-in.

get.summary: Every role: built-in first, then by name.

post.summary: Creates a role from catalog permissions.

get.summary: One role; the ETag is the row's version.

put.summary: Replaces a role's name, description and permissions; If-Match required; built-in roles are read-only.

delete.summary: Deletes a role and its assignments; built-in roles cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Creates an editable copy of a role (the way to customise a built-in one).

get.summary: A user's role assignments, active and expired.

post.summary: Assigns a role everywhere (no site) or at one site, optionally until a date.

get.summary: GET: the license page.

delete.summary: DELETE: removes a key by id.

get.summary: GET: the comparison with the installed tier marked.
The organization's name and logo, for the login page; 404 until the first-run wizard created it.
The organization; the ETag is the row's version; 404 until the first-run wizard created it.

post.summary: Creates the organization (the first-run wizard's first step); 409 when it already exists.

put.summary: Replaces the organization's details; If-Match required.

get.summary: Every site the caller may see (all with an organization-level grant, their own with site-level grants), active and retired, in code order.

post.summary: Creates a site; 409 sites.code_taken when the code is in use.

get.summary: One site; the ETag is the row's version.

put.summary: Replaces a site's details; If-Match required; 409 sites.has_open_releases when retiring a site with open releases.

get.summary: Every zone of the site, active and retired, in code order.

post.summary: Creates a zone in the site; 409 zones.code_taken when the code is in use there.

get.summary: One zone; the ETag is the row's version.

put.summary: Replaces a zone's details; If-Match required; 409 zones.has_open_groups when retiring a zone with open groups.

get.summary: One page of the site's locations (after/before cursor, sort=walk_sequence|code|barcode|id, size, id_from/id_to, zone_id).

post.summary: Creates a location in the site; 409 locations.code_taken or locations.barcode_taken when in use there.

get.summary: One location; the ETag is the row's version.

put.summary: Replaces a location's details; If-Match required.

post.summary: Loads a zones file (JSON array of zones plus action) into the site; policy=all_or_nothing (default)|accept_valid_rows|validate_only; format=csv for the row results as CSV.
Loads a locations file (JSON array of locations with zoneCode plus action) into the site; policy=accept_valid_rows (default)|all_or_nothing|validate_only; format=csv for the row results as CSV.
Copies the site (settings overrides, zones, locations as chosen) under a new code; the copy carries copiedFromId.
Copies the zone within or across sites (settings overrides, locations with a code-prefix substitution as chosen).
Copies the location with a new code and barcode.
Copies every location whose code starts with a prefix, substituting the prefix in codes and barcodes; all or nothing.

siteId.description: The site, or null for everywhere.

expiresAt.description: When the assignment stops applying, or null for no expiry.

healthy.description: True when the provider can sign people in.

detail.description: What was checked, or why it failed; never a secret.

AuthProviderHealth.description: The result of a provider's health check (E11.0).

challengeUrl.description: Where the browser goes for a challenge provider; null for a credentials one.

AuthProviderInfo.description: One enabled provider as the login page sees it (E11.0).

AuthProviderKind.description: How a provider signs a console user in (E11.0).

area.description: The area the name is grouped under (the part before the first dot).

cells.description: One cell per tier, in the table's tier order: "✓" or "—" for a feature, the number or "unlimited" for a limit.

ComparisonRow.description: One row of the feature comparison (E79.10): a feature or a limit and its cell per tier.

CoverageStatus.description: Whether this release is covered by the base key (E79.5).

minutes.description: How long, up to the `logging.elevation_max_minutes` setting.

ElevateLogLevelRequest.description: A timed elevation as posted (E12.4): "Debug for 30 minutes".

tiers.description: The tier names across the top, lowest first.

installedTier.description: The tier in force here, for the console to highlight; null on the docs page.

FeatureComparison.description: The feature-by-tier table for a release (E79.10), generated from the same tier table the enforcement uses, so it can never disagree with what the product does.

group.description: The group identifier as the provider sends it.

siteId.description: The site, or null for everywhere.

provider.description: The provider whose groups these are.

group.description: The group identifier as the provider sends it (an object id, a name, a DN).

siteId.description: The site the role applies at, or null for everywhere.

GroupRoleMappingInfo.description: One directory group mapped to one role (E11.2), everywhere or at one site.

ImportAction.description: What a row asks for (E16.6): an upsert by natural key (the default) or a soft delete.

ImportPolicy.description: What an import does with bad rows (E16.6), chosen per run with a default per entity type.

entity.description: The entity type the file carried (`zones`, `locations`).

policy.description: The bad-row policy the run used.

written.description: True when the rows were written; false under ImportPolicy.ValidateOnly and for a rolled-back ImportPolicy.AllOrNothing run.

updated.description: Rows whose key existed and changed.

ImportResult.description: What an import run produced (E16.6): the counts, whether anything was written, and one line per row. The same shape is returned by the API, shown in the console and downloadable as CSV (string ImportResult.ToCsv()).

ImportRowOutcome.description: What happened to one row (E16.6), or what would have happened under ImportPolicy.ValidateOnly and for the valid rows of a rolled-back ImportPolicy.AllOrNothing run.

row.description: The row's position in the file, starting at 1.

key.description: The row's natural key (zone code, bin code); blank when the row had none.

outcome.description: What happened, or would have happened.

code.description: The error code when the row failed; null otherwise.

message.description: Why the row failed; null otherwise.

ImportRowResult.description: One row of an import result (E16.6): the same shape in the API, the console and the downloadable CSV.

keyId.description: The key id (or the line, for a document that could not be read).

oneOf.description: Base or add-on; null when unreadable.

tier.description: The tier of a base key.

organization.description: The organization the key binds to.

coverageFrom.description: The first covered day, or null when perpetual or co-terminating.

coverageTo.description: The last covered day, or null when perpetual or co-terminating.

reason.description: Why, for a status other than active.

summary.description: One line: "Pro base, covered to 2027-03-31" or "+10 devices".

InstalledKeyInfo.description: One installed key on the license page (E79.11): what it adds, its coverage and its status.

InstallLicenseKeyRequest.description: The body of `PUT /system/license/keys` (E79.3): the signed document as issued.

KeyStatus.description: How an installed key takes part in the effective license (E79.11).

organization.description: The organization the base key binds to; empty on the free tier.

coveredUntil.description: The last covered day, or null when perpetual.

releaseDate.description: Its date, the one coverage is checked against.

banners.description: What the console shows at the top: lapsed coverage, limits over, warnings.

LicenseStatus.description: The license page (E79.6, E79.11): the tier and coverage, every feature granted, every limit with its usage, the device totals ("5 included + 10 purchased = 15"), every installed key, and the banners.

LimitOutcome.description: What a creation against a limit may do (E79.4).

ceiling.description: The licensed value, or null when unlimited.

percent.description: Count as a percentage of the ceiling, or null when unlimited.

warning.description: True when the count has reached the warning threshold.

outcome.description: The standing: allowed, within the allowance (grace running), or blocked.

graceEndsOn.description: The last day of grace while over, else null.

message.description: The banner while over, else empty.

LimitUsage.description: One limit on the license page (E79.6): the licensed value, the count now, and the standing.

localLoginOpen.description: True when a local sign-in may proceed right now.

ssoVerified.description: True once an external sign-in has succeeded on this install.

unlockedUntil.description: End of the open unlock window; null when no window is open.

forcedLocal.description: True when `Wms:Auth:ForceLocal` keeps local sign-in open regardless.

LocalLoginStatus.description: Whether local sign-in is open (`GET /auth/local/status`, E9.3): read anonymously by the login page (to hide or show the password form) and by the console (to show the unlock banner). Carries no user names.

code.description: The new bin code, unique within the site.

barcode.description: The new barcode, unique within the site.

walkSequence.description: The new walk sequence; null to keep the source's.

zoneId.description: The zone to copy into; null for the source location's zone.

LocationCopyRequest.description: What an administrator sends to copy one location (E16.5): the same properties with a new code and barcode.

code.description: The bin code, unique within the site: letters, digits, `-` and `_`, compared without regard to case (the site's code format, E17.11, generates it from aisle/bay/level/position).

barcode.description: The label on the bin, unique within the site; what a picker scans.

zoneId.description: The zone the bin is in; a zone of the same site.

walkSequence.description: A sortable string: the order a picker walks the bins in. Starts with the zone's walk-order prefix when the zone has one.

isPickable.description: False for a bin that holds stock but is never picked from (staging, overflow).

isActive.description: False to retire the bin: it stays in history but takes no new stock or tasks.

LocationDraft.description: What an administrator (or an import) sends to create or replace a location (E17.1): one bin.

code.description: The natural key: the bin code, unique within the site.

barcode.description: The label on the bin, unique within the site.

zoneCode.description: The code of a zone of the site; it must already exist.

walkSequence.description: The sortable walk order; starts with the zone's walk-order prefix when it has one.

isPickable.description: False for a bin never picked from.

LocationImportRow.description: One location in a locations file (E16.6): the same object as LocationDraft except that the zone is named by its code (the natural key an ERP or a spreadsheet knows), plus the optional ImportAction LocationImportRow.Action.

siteId.description: The site the bin belongs to.

zoneId.description: The zone the bin is in.

code.description: The bin code, unique within the site.

barcode.description: The label on the bin, unique within the site.

isPickable.description: False for a bin never picked from.

isActive.description: False once the bin is retired.

updatedAt.description: When the row was last written (UTC).

rowVersion.description: The row's version (E5.1); the string LocationInfo.Etag is derived from it.

copiedFromId.description: The id of the row this one was copied from (E16.5); null when created outright.

etag.description: The entity tag a client sends back in `If-Match`.

LocationInfo.description: A location as the API reports it (E17.1): one bin in a zone of a site.

codePrefixFrom.description: The prefix the source codes start with.

codePrefixTo.description: The replacement prefix for the copies' codes and barcodes.

zoneId.description: The zone the copies go to; null to keep each source's zone.

walkPrefixFrom.description: Optional: the prefix of the source walk sequences to replace.

walkPrefixTo.description: The replacement walk prefix; required when WalkPrefixFrom is given.

LocationRangeCopyRequest.description: What an administrator sends to copy a range of locations at once (E16.5), such as aisle `A` to aisle `B`: every location whose code starts with the prefix is copied with the prefix replaced in its code and barcode (and, optionally, its walk sequence).

oneOf.description: The elevated level while an elevation runs, else null.

elevatedUntil.description: When the elevation ends, else null.

maxElevationMinutes.description: The longest elevation the console may start.

LoggingStatus.description: The server's log level as the console shows it (E12.4).

line2.description: Second line (suite, building); null when none.

region.description: State, province or county; null when the country has none.

country.description: Country, as written on an envelope.

OrganizationAddress.description: The organisation's postal address (E16.0), as printed on cards and digests.

phone.description: Their phone number; null when none.

OrganizationContact.description: A named contact of the organisation (E16.0): the primary contact the vendor and the install talk to, and the support contact users are pointed at.

name.description: The name users see: console header, login page, notifications, cards; 1–128 characters.

legalName.description: The registered company name; null to use Name.

logoDataUrl.description: The logo as a `data:image/…` URL, at most 256 KB; null for none.

timeZone.description: The default time zone (IANA or Windows id), the one sites inherit.

locale.description: The default culture name (`en-US`), the one users inherit.

oneOf.description: The postal address; null when not yet known.
Who the vendor and the install talk to; null when not yet known.
Who users are pointed at; null to use the primary contact.

OrganizationDraft.description: Body of `POST /organization` (the first-run wizard's first step) and `PUT /organization` (E16.0).

legalName.description: The registered company name; null to use Name.

logoDataUrl.description: The logo as a `data:image/…` URL; null for none.

oneOf.description: The postal address; null when not yet known.
Who the vendor and the install talk to; null when not yet known.
Who users are pointed at; null to use the primary contact.

updatedAt.description: When the row was last written (UTC).

rowVersion.description: The row's version (the entity tag on updates).

OrganizationInfo.description: The organisation as the API and the console see it (E16.0): the one row per install that is the top of the settings cascade, the name on the console header, the licensee the keys name, and the install's name in multi-install monitoring.

logoDataUrl.description: The logo as a `data:image/…` URL; null for none.

OrganizationPublicInfo.description: The organisation as the login page shows it before anyone is signed in (E16.0): the name and the logo, nothing that identifies people or places.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the page after this one (`after=`), or null on the last page.

previousCursor.description: Cursor for the page before this one (`before=`), or null on the first page.

minId.description: Lowest id matching the filters in scope, or null when empty.

maxId.description: Highest id matching the filters in scope, or null when empty.

items.description: The items on this page, never null.

totalCount.description: Exact total in scope; never negative.

PageOfLocationInfo.description: One keyset page of a list endpoint (E82.3): the items, opaque cursors for the neighbouring pages, the exact total in scope, and the id bounds so a parallel client can split the range with `id_from`/`id_to`.

module.description: The module that declares it (`console` for workspaces).

PermissionDescriptor.description: One catalog entry as the API and the console see it (E10.1).

restockingBin.description: The bin (a location barcode or label, E17.1) resolved stock is restocked to; null when none.

returnsContainer.description: The container returns are collected in; null when none.

resolverUserIds.description: The users assigned to resolve here; empty when anyone with the permission may.

acceptsWeightFailures.description: Whether totes that failed the weight check are routed here.

acceptsShorts.description: Whether short picks are resolved here.

acceptsAdjustments.description: Whether quantity adjustments are resolved here.

acceptsMisdirects.description: Whether misdirected totes are resolved here.

isVirtualQueue.description: True for a virtual queue (work items, no conveyor lane); false for a physical lane.

ResolutionZone.description: The properties only a ZoneType.Resolution zone carries (E16.2): where resolved stock goes, who resolves, which exceptions it accepts, and whether it is a physical lane or a virtual queue.

siteId.description: The site, or null for everywhere (the organisation).

expiresAt.description: When the assignment stops applying, or null for no expiry.

expired.description: True when DateTimeOffset? RoleAssignmentInfo.ExpiresAt has passed.

RoleAssignmentInfo.description: One role assignment (E10.3): a user holds a role everywhere or at one site, optionally until a date.

permissions.description: Catalog permission names the role grants.

builtIn.description: The built-in role key (`administrator`) when the role is one, else null; built-in roles are read-only.

permissions.description: The permission names the role grants, sorted; `*` for the administrator.

rowVersion.description: The row's version (the entity tag on updates).

RoleInfo.description: A role as the API and the console see it (E10.2).

current.description: Identifier of the last applied migration, or null when no database is reachable or none was applied.

expected.description: Identifier of the last migration this build ships, or null before the data model exists.

upToDate.description: True when the database is at exactly the migration this build expects.

SchemaStatus.description: The database schema as the API sees it (E82.5): the migration the database is at and the one this build expects. Read-only; applying migrations is a bootstrap step outside the API (`wms-migrate`).

mustChangePassword.description: True while the password must be replaced before anything else.

permissions.description: The permission grants the session carries (`name@organization`, `name@site:3`, `*@organization`).

mode.description: The cascade mode's stored name, or null to keep or set a value.

SetSettingRequest.description: Body of `PUT /settings/{scope}/{id}/{key}` (E6.3, E7.2): a value as stored text, or a cascade mode (`per_site`, `per_zone`, `per_sku`) that delegates the decision downward. Both null resets the scope to inherit (the same as `DELETE`); mode `value` alone does the same.

kind.description: How the value is edited and stored.

scopes.description: The scope names the setting may be configured at, organisation first.

default.description: The default value as stored text; masked for secrets.

choices.description: The allowed values when the kind is a fixed list, else null.

requiresRestart.description: True when a change needs a host restart.

triggersDeviceResync.description: True when a change makes devices resync.

SettingDescriptor.description: One registry entry as the API and the console see it (E6.1): everything a settings page needs to render and validate a setting without knowing its CLR type.

SettingKind.description: How a setting's value is edited and stored (E6.1). Every value is stored as invariant-culture text; the kind tells the settings page which editor to show and the accessor how to parse the text.

configuredValue.description: The text configured at this scope, or null when it inherits.

effectiveValue.description: The text that applies at this scope.

inheritedFrom.description: The scope the effective value comes from (`organization`), `default` for the key's default, or null when configured here.

cascadeMode.description: How this scope takes part in the cascade: `value`, or `per_site`/`per_zone`/`per_sku` when it delegates (E7.2).

allowedModes.description: The modes this key allows at this scope.

rowVersion.description: The stored row's version, or null when no row exists at this scope yet.

updatedBy.description: Who last wrote the row, if one exists.

updatedAt.description: When the row was last written, if one exists.

etag.description: The entity tag of the stored row (`If-Match` on writes), or null when no row exists.

SettingValue.description: One setting at one scope as the API and the console see it (E6.3): what is configured here, what applies here, and where the effective value comes from when it is inherited. Secrets are masked.

code.description: The new site's code, unique across sites.

timeZone.description: The new site's time zone; null to keep the source site's.

settings.description: Bring the source site's settings overrides (configured values and cascade modes; secrets are never copied).

zones.description: Bring the zones with their reject-lane flags, resolution properties and settings overrides.

locations.description: Bring the locations (requires Zones), with the code substitution applied to codes and barcodes.

codePrefixFrom.description: Optional: the prefix of the source codes and barcodes to replace (a renumbering such as aisle `A` to `B`).

codePrefixTo.description: The replacement prefix; required when CodePrefixFrom is given.

SiteCopyRequest.description: What an administrator sends to copy a site (E16.5): the fields that must differ and a checklist of what to bring. Transactional data and pickers' assignments are never copied.

code.description: The short unique code (`DC1`, `HAM-01`): letters, digits, `-` and `_`, compared without regard to case.

timeZone.description: An IANA or Windows time zone id the host knows; what the site's clocks, cut-offs and digests use. Null or blank to take the organisation's default time zone (E16.4); required until the organisation exists.

isActive.description: False to retire the site: it stays in reports and history but takes no new work. Refused while open releases exist.

SiteDraft.description: What an administrator sends to create or replace a site (E16.1).

id.description: The server-assigned identifier; what `siteId` route values and `X-Wms-Site` carry.

isActive.description: False once the site is retired.

updatedAt.description: When the row was last written (UTC).

rowVersion.description: The row's version (E5.1); the string SiteInfo.Etag is derived from it.

copiedFromId.description: The id of the row this one was copied from (E16.5); null when created outright.

etag.description: The entity tag a client sends back in `If-Match`.

SiteInfo.description: A site as the API reports it (E16.1): one warehouse, the operational level pickers, role assignments and settings are scoped to.

code.description: The new zone's code, unique within the target site.

targetSiteId.description: The site to copy into; null for the source zone's own site.

settings.description: Bring the zone's settings overrides (secrets are never copied).

locations.description: Bring the zone's locations, with the code substitution applied to codes and barcodes.

codePrefixFrom.description: Optional: the prefix of the source location codes and barcodes to replace; required when copying locations within the same site.

codePrefixTo.description: The replacement prefix; required when CodePrefixFrom is given.

ZoneCopyRequest.description: What an administrator sends to copy a zone within or across sites (E16.5).

code.description: The code, unique within the site: letters, digits, `-` and `_`, compared without regard to case.

walkOrderPrefix.description: An optional sortable prefix the zone's locations' walk sequences start with (E17.1); null for none.

isRejectLane.description: True when a pick zone is also the conveyor's error/overflow lane; drives the reject diagnostics (E26.3). Pick zones only.

oneOf.description: The resolution-zone properties; required for a ZoneType.Resolution zone, absent otherwise.

isActive.description: False to retire the zone. Refused while open zone groups exist.

ZoneDraft.description: What an administrator sends to create or replace a zone (E16.2).

code.description: The natural key: the zone's code, unique within the site.

walkOrderPrefix.description: The optional sortable prefix the zone's locations' walk sequences start with.

isRejectLane.description: True when a pick zone is also the conveyor's error/overflow lane.

ZoneImportRow.description: One zone in a zones file (E16.6): the same object as ZoneDraft plus the optional ImportAction ZoneImportRow.Action. Resolution zones are not importable (E16.2): a row with `type: Resolution` fails.

siteId.description: The site the zone belongs to.

code.description: The code, unique within the site.

walkOrderPrefix.description: The sortable prefix of the zone's locations' walk sequences; null for none.

isRejectLane.description: True when the pick zone is also the conveyor's error/overflow lane.

oneOf.description: The resolution-zone properties; null for pick and bulk zones.

isActive.description: False once the zone is retired.

updatedAt.description: When the row was last written (UTC).

rowVersion.description: The row's version (E5.1); the string ZoneInfo.Etag is derived from it.

copiedFromId.description: The id of the row this one was copied from (E16.5); null when created outright.

etag.description: The entity tag a client sends back in `If-Match`.

ZoneInfo.description: A zone as the API reports it (E16.2): a picking area, bulk storage or resolution zone within a site.
